question: To obtain a virtual erect image by reflection from a concave mirror of focal length 20 cm, the object should be placed :
solution:
The correct answer is **'__between 0-20 cm__'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Concave mirror:**

__
 
• If the reflection takes place from the inner surface of a spherical mirror, then the mirror is called a concave mirror.
 
• It is also known ahh
 
• Depending on the point of the object: 

 
• **The image may be real or virtual.**
 
• **Image may be erect or inverted.**
 
• **image may be magnified or diminished.**

 
• they are used widely, for example-** Shaving mirrors, Doctor's head mirrors, ophthalmoscopes, Headlights, solar furnaces, etc.**

**Explanation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f88761c592d4278ea23120ca5422a785adba5ce0a3b9c7623567bbc7f26ed24c.png] 

The focal length of a concave mirror = 20 cm

The image formed by concave mirror = Virtual erect image

 
• The Virtual Image is formed when the object is placed** between the principal focus and the pole**.
 
• Also,** Focal length** is the distance between the pole and the principal focus.
 
• Here, The focal length is given as 20 Cm, so the most correct answer is from 0 cm to 20 cm.

Thus, **the correct answer is 0-20cm. **
